prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1184; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for giving us a few minutes today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Conroe, Texas. Can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle you were operating at the time?

A: Yes, I was driving my own car.

Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was pulling out of a parking space near the store entrance. It was a busy afternoon, and the lot was pretty crowded.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?

A: Not really. I glanced to my left, saw nothing coming, and started backing out. Then I felt a jolt from the rear passenger side.

Q: What was the speed of your vehicle when contact occurred?

A: I was moving very slowly, probably a walking pace. I wasn't going fast at all.

Q: Did either vehicle sustain visible damage?

A: My rear bumper was scraped and the other car had a dent in its front quarter panel, as far as I could tell.

Q: Were you injured in the collision?

A: Yes. I hit my head on the steering wheel and I've been dealing with a concussion since. I get headaches, I'm sensitive to light, and I've had trouble concentrating at work.

Q: Have you received medical treatment for those symptoms?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same day, and I'm now seeing a doctor for follow-up appointments.

Q: Did anyone else witness the collision?

A: I think a woman in the next row saw it, but I didn't get her name.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm sorry for the mess, and I'm hoping to get my car repaired soon. Thank you.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
